scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy

SESSION_SECRET.description: Use a private random value of at least 32 characters. Do not reuse an account password.

TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Optional unless Google Calendar is enabled. Use a base64-encoded random 32-byte key.

WORKER_SECRET.description: Optional demo job-runner secret. Use a long random value if scheduled jobs are enabled.

LLM_API_KEY.description: Optional. Leave empty to use ArogyaFlow's deterministic AI-summary fallback.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Optional. Leave empty while DEMO_MODE is true.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional. Add only when configuring Google Calendar OAuth.
